[10:52] Oaspete (Dan Oprean): Bună ziua! Am plecat din apartament. Mulțumim frumos pentru găzduire. O zi deosebită!

[14:02] Oaspete (Laura Radu): Buna Alexandru, te-as ruga sa te uiti peste refund request-ul le care l-am facut intrucat mare parte din excursia noastra la bucuresti a fost afectata de variile probleme din apartament. Merci
 Mesaj tradus: Hi, Alexandru. Could you please review the refund request I submitted, as a significant portion of our trip to Bucharest was impacted by various issues in the apartment? Thank you.

apartments.name: Campineanu22 A
urgente_mesaje:
[18:05] Oaspete (Philippe Caloin): Bonjour Alexandru.
Merci pour ces informations utiles.
Notre avion atterrit à 10h, nous arriverons donc en ville pour manger.
Est-il possible d'accéder plus tôt à l'appartement ?
Si ok, à partir de quelle heure ?
Bonne soirée.
Philippe 
 Mesaj tradus: Hello Alexandru.
Thanks for the useful information.
Our plane lands at 10:00 a.m., so we'll be in town in time for lunch.
Is it possible to access the apartment earlier?
If so, from what time?
Have a good night.
Philippe
